# apicurio_current_user (Data Source)

How the registry sees the provider's credentials: the principal and its roles. On a registry without authorization the anonymous caller is an admin with an empty `username`. On a secured registry an empty `username` means the credentials were not accepted and the registry fell back to the anonymous user; all three role flags `false` means the principal has no role mapping yet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# How the registry sees the provider's credentials; useful to debug
# authentication and roles before managing anything.
data "apicurio_current_user" "me" {}

output "registry_user" {
  value = {
    username  = data.apicurio_current_user.me.username
    admin     = data.apicurio_current_user.me.admin
    developer = data.apicurio_current_user.me.developer
    viewer    = data.apicurio_current_user.me.viewer
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `admin` (Boolean) Whether the principal has the admin role.
- `developer` (Boolean) Whether the principal has the developer role.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the principal.
- `id` (String) The registry URL.
- `username` (String) Principal id (the `preferred_username` claim or the service account name); empty for the anonymous user.
- `viewer` (Boolean) Whether the principal has the read-only role.
